(3) The corporation may acquire, purchase, take,
hold and enjoy movable|and immovable property of
every description, and sell, convey, assign, surrender
and yield up, mortgage, charge, demise, re-assign,
transfer or otherwise  an of any movable and
immovable property vested in the corporation upon
such terms as to the corporation seems fit.

3. All deeds, documents and other instruments
requiring the seal of the corporation shall be sealed
with the seal of the corporation in the presence of the
officer for the time being] discharging the duties of the
office of Chief Social‘ Welfare Officer, Federation of
Malaya, who shall sign every such deed, document or
other instrument to which the corporate seal is affixed,
and such signing shall he sufficient evidence that the
said seal was duly and properly affixed and that the
same is the lawful seal of the corporation.

4, A notification in the Gazette of the appointment
of any person to hold or act in the office of Chief Social
Welfare Officer, Federation of Malaya, shall be
conclusive evidence that such person was duly so
appointed.
